description:
61 Woodlands is a well-proportioned four bedroom semi-detached family home offering an excellent opportunity for those looking to create their ideal home. With generous accommodation throughout and fantastic potential, this property is ready for its next owners to add their own personal style. This property benefits from its convenient location to Navan and a south-facing, very private rear garden allowing plenty of sunshine and many other features. The property definitely has the charm of well-settled area and will appeal to those looking for a home close to Navan town. 
Early viewings are highly recommended.

Woodlands is located within walking distance to Navan town centre with amenities near by including shops, restaurants, schools and Beachmount Shopping Centre with Supervalu. Mercy Convent National School, St. Josephs Mercy Secondary School and Beaufort College are all within walking distance from the property. Access to M3 motorway linking Navan town to Dublin City & Airport is easily reached.
